title: Quantitative analysis of RNA 3′-end processing using chromatin-associated RNA-seq data
author: Huang, Bao, et al.

steps.title: Pretreat cells with doxycycline
steps.instruction: Incubate mouse embryonic stem (mES) cells with 1 μg/mL doxycycline for 12 hours.

steps.title: Auxin treatment of degron cells
steps.instruction: Treat RPB3 or dRPB3 degron mES cells with either 500 μM indole‑3‑acetic acid (auxin/IAA) or no auxin, according to experimental design.

steps.title: Collect cells and add spike‑in
steps.instruction: Harvest approximately 1 × 10⁷ mES cells and mix them with Drosophila S2 cells at 10 % (v/v) to serve as spike‑in control.

steps.title: Lyse cells in NP‑40 buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell mixture in ice‑cold NP‑40 lysis buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.5; 150 mM NaCl; 0.05 % NP‑40; 1 × proteinase inhibitor cocktail) and incubate for 5 minutes on ice.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei via sucrose cushion
steps.instruction: Layer the lysate gently onto a sucrose cushion (24 % sucrose in the same NP‑40 lysis buffer) and centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 minutes. Discard the supernatant (cytoplasmic fraction) and resuspend the resulting pellet in 0.5 mL glycerol buffer.

steps.title: Lyse nuclei and remove nucleoplasm
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL nuclei lysis buffer to the resuspended nuclei, incubate on ice for 2 minutes, then centrifuge the mixture and discard the supernatant (nucleoplasmic fraction).

steps.title: Wash chromatin pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the remaining chromatin pellet twice with ice‑cold PBS, discarding the wash supernatants each time.

steps.title: Extract RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the washed chromatin pellet using TRIzol reagent following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Submit RNA for library preparation
steps.instruction: Send the purified RNA samples to Novogene for ribosomal RNA depletion, strand‑specific library construction, and high‑throughput sequencing.

steps.title: Compute readthrough index with DESeq2
steps.instruction: Analyze the sequencing data to calculate differential 3′‑end processing by fitting negative‑binomial generalized linear models in the DESeq2 R package to obtain readthrough index changes.

steps.title: Assess statistical significance
steps.instruction: Evaluate the significance of readthrough index changes using a two‑sided Wilcoxon rank‑sum test.

description: This section includes the minimal hardware requirements, the installation procedures of essential tools, as well as the construction of RPB3 and dRPB3 degron systems in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), which are the fundamental cell lines used for creating ChAR-seq libraries and subsequent sequencing.
